verdict.rationale: Cake's docs cover every named instrument: share classes and class conversions, digital share certificates (holdings and transactional types, plus uploading previously issued ones), SAFEs and convertibles, and option grants with NSO/ISO support and a vesting engine. These sit on a live cap table, and investors view their holdings through the My Cake portal. Missing for 10: any evidence of auditor-facing features (audit trail, change history, auditor access), and independent or hands-on corroboration, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
